answer:
The changelog shows that Python 3.9 support was deprecated in March 2026. The same entry appears in several packages' release notes:

- "chore: deprecate python 3.9 once and for all" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md], under llama-index-instrumentation 0.5.0 (2026-03-16) and llama-index-embeddings-litellm 0.5.0 (2026-03-16).
- The same wording appears under llama-index-embeddings-llamafile 0.5.0 (2026-03-16), llama-index-embeddings-autoembeddings 0.3.0 (2026-03-12), and llama-index-embeddings-azure-inference 0.5.0 (2026-03-12) [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md].

The entries all link to PR #20956. The word "deprecate" suggests 3.9 is being phased out, but the changelog does not say whether 3.9 is fully unsupported or removed from the packages' metadata. I also can't confirm the status of every LlamaIndex package, only the ones listed above.

For comparison, the changelog records an earlier drop of Python 3.8 in llama-index-core 0.12.0 (2024-11-17): "Dropped python3.8 support, Unpinned numpy (#16973)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/CHANGELOG.md].
